APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

silicone coaster, mat or tray

Outdoor Bars ↗

A silicone mat with a raised edge: Full-bleed print puts the logo under every guest's hand.

Backyard BBQ ↗

Rolled up and rinsed at the end instead of scrubbing cloth.

Corporate Events & Branded Gifts ↗

The cheapest piece in a set, and the one with the biggest print area.

Confirm for your project

Check service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions；the printable area, what goes in the set and how it is packed.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
